faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Common questions about GPT-Image-1 Text to Image

q1.question: What is GPT-Image-1?
q1.answer: GPT-Image-1 is OpenAI's AI image generation model that creates images from text descriptions. It's particularly strong at rendering readable text within images.

q2.question: How accurate is the text rendering?
q2.answer: GPT-Image-1 generates legible text better than most AI models. It handles multiple text elements and dense typography. For pixel-perfect text in critical applications, generate the base image here and add final text in design software.

q3.question: Can I get transparent backgrounds?
q3.answer: Yes. Choose PNG output format and include "transparent background" in your prompt. Useful for logos, stickers, and composite assets.

q4.question: What styles can it generate?
q4.answer: Photorealism, illustration, concept art, digital painting, vintage aesthetics, minimalist design, and more. Reference specific styles in your prompt.

q5.question: When should I use Seedream 4.5 instead?
q5.answer: Use Seedream 4.5 when you need bilingual prompt support (Chinese) or want to maintain character consistency across generations. Use GPT-Image-1 when text rendering quality is the priority.
